stage1.impression: A clean, legible range shot: eight tinted acrylic cabinets in spectrum order on pale paper, each throwing a coloured patch onto the floor, and the colour idea reads at once. But it reads as a tidy CG lineup, not a photograph: a flat frontal row of evenly spaced, toy-scaled units with pitch-black holes in every horn, heavy neutral-grey shadow slabs that outweigh the coloured light, fanning shadows from a near lamp, a soft cove horizon behind the horns and an empty lower fifth.

blocking_9: The speakers read at their real 1.3 m scale: a lower eye point, not a toy-like view from above a flat row
The 20 mm acrylic edges and the cabinets' depth are visible (speakers turned off-axis), so the material reads as thick cast acrylic, not tinted film
Coloured light, not neutral grey shadow, is the dominant element on the floor
No crushed-black holes in the horns; the throat and driver read as shaped objects
One coherent light: parallel shadows from a distant key, and cabinet faces that look lit by that world rather than by a separate frontal lamp
No visible cove/horizon line behind the horns
Every speaker's shadow and colour cast falls inside the frame, and the lower fifth carries image, not empty paper

defects.what: Horn throats render as pure black blobs (throat region crush 90 %, median 0); they read as holes punched in the image
Soft cove/horizon line behind the horns (step about -15 over 47 px), reads as a seam and cuts through the horns
Flat, evenly spaced frontal row; the 0.3 m arc is invisible, no side faces or acrylic edges show, so the units read small and flat like icons
Shadows are dense neutral grey (median 113 against paper 238) and occupy more area than the coloured casts, which only appear at the shadow tips
Red (and on the right, black) shadow and cast fan outward and run off the frame edges; fanning shadows betray a near point lamp
Smoked black unit is a nearly featureless dark block (median 21), little light or edge definition
Cabinet faces are evenly front-lit against a backlit world (face lamp), so the product looks lit separately from the set
Bottom fifth is empty smooth paper with a slight gradient, no grain or content; dead space
Green cast is muddy and desaturated (RGB 143/153/137) compared with the blue cast (136/168/202)

changes.problem: The view from 2.4 m over a flat row makes 1.3 m loudspeakers read as small desk objects and wastes the bottom fifth on empty paper.

evidence.measured: bottom 130 px is featureless paper, lum median 223, range 19; speaker tops sit at y 172 while the camera looks down on them

change.to: (0, -15.0, 1.35), 70 mm, extra shift +0.03 so the casts end about 8 % above the bottom edge and the horns stay below the top fifth

changes.expected: Speakers gain stature at near eye level, casts foreshorten into the lower third and fill it, the empty band at the bottom disappears.

changes.problem: A dead-straight frontal lineup hides the acrylic's thickness and side faces, which is what makes it read as a real material.

evidence.measured: every cabinet shows a pure front elevation; no side face or edge highlight is visible on any unit

change.from: arc depth 0.3 m, turn 0.0 deg toward the middle, centres 0.8 m
change.to: arc depth 0.9 m, turn 12 deg toward the middle, centres 0.85 m

changes.expected: Each cabinet shows a sliver of side face and lit 20 mm edges; the row gains depth and reads as an arc.

changes.problem: The key is close enough that shadows fan outward, run off both frame edges and betray a near lamp rather than one sun-like source.

evidence.measured: red cast reaches the left edge (lum 152, R 206) and the black unit's shadow exits right; shadow axes diverge from the centre

change.to: 1.2 m disc at (0, 30.0, 18.0) aimed at (0, -2, 0), 5.5 W/m2 at target (same elevation, shadows near-parallel)

changes.expected: Shadows and casts run straight toward the camera under their own speakers; nothing leaves the frame edges.

changes.problem: Neutral grey shadow slabs outweigh the coloured light, so the image is about shadows rather than colour through acrylic.

evidence.measured: shadow median 113 vs paper 238 (more than one stop and a half darker); coloured patches occupy roughly a third of the shadow area

changes.expected: Shadows lift to a soft mid-grey so the coloured casts dominate the floor; shadow median about 150.

changes.problem: Horn throats render as pure black holes that pull the eye and read as render artefacts.

change.from: linked to woofer cones, surrounds and caps only
change.to: also linked to the horn throat and compression driver body, or add a 2 x 0.3 m strip at (0, -6, 2.2), 6 W/m2, linked to those parts only

changes.expected: Throat and driver show a rounded form with a soft highlight, still the darkest part of the horn but not a hole.

changes.problem: A soft horizon at the cove runs straight through the horns and reads as a seam in the set.

evidence.measured: edge step -14.9 over 47 px at about y 198

change.to: cyc 13.0 W/m2, top 11.0 W/m2 so the floor behind the line matches the wall

changes.expected: Wall and floor merge into one continuous pale field behind the horns; no visible line.

changes.problem: The smoked black unit is a featureless block and all cabinets look front-lit by a separate lamp rather than by the backlit world.

evidence.measured: black unit median 21, p95 51; green cabinet median 58 under a frontal 8 W/m2 face lamp

change.from: 4 x 2 m at (0, -10.0, 2.6), 8.0 W/m2, no reflection
change.to: two 0.6 x 3 m strips at (+/-6, -3, 1.4) aimed at the line, 6 W/m2 each, linked to cabinets, reflections on; face lowered to 4.0 W/m2

changes.expected: Each cabinet gets lit side edges and a long specular down its acrylic corners; the black unit reads through its edges; fronts look naturally lit.

changes.problem: The floor between the speakers sits at the white point and the paper has no visible tooth, which keeps the set looking synthetic.

change.from: white point 228 -> 238, shoulder to 251; paper tooth 0.3 at 1.2 mm
change.to: white point 228 -> 234, shoulder to 246; paper tooth 0.5 at 3 mm, mottle 0.06

changes.expected: Paper holds a faint tone and grain everywhere; no near-clipped patches; title area stays clean pale.

out_of_scope.request: Make the green tint cleaner and more saturated
out_of_scope.why: The cast is muddy (RGB 143/153/137) but the colour is the speaker's own tint, which is fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Lighten the smoked black cabinet's tint
out_of_scope.why: Its colour is part of the product; only lighting can help it read.

out_of_scope.request: Simplify the visible internal hardware (feet balls, brackets) seen through the clear acrylic
out_of_scope.why: The internal parts are the speaker's own; they add busyness but cannot be changed.
